results.content: # AI Productivity Leaks: Rethinking ROI in Hybrid Workforces. ## The Paradox: Individual AI Gains ≠ Bottom-Line Impact. In our podcast and newsletter from March 12, we discussed the **challenges of measuring AI ROI and Productivity Leaks**. The story is the same across industries: **Individuals report 20-30% productivity boosts from AI tools, with super users seeing up to 100% gains**. We’d never go back to work without AI. ## 👥 From Individual Contributors to Hybrid Human-AI Production Units. **Every worker is becoming the leader of a hybrid human-AI production unit**. We started discussing this concept with: **Agentic AI: Orchestrating Your Digital Workforce**. > Two parallel transformations are reshaping our economic landscape: **AI-driven productivity gains and the fundamental evolution of what it means to manage**. From students to CEOs, every person is now the leader of a production unit—comprised of themselves and their AI team members. Deloitte and EY just launched advanced AI agent platforms with Nvidia, marking the “third wave of AI.” Deloitte’s CEO calls this the dawn of the “autonomous enterprise era,” shifting from task automation to AI as “intelligent digital workers.” EY deployed 150 AI tax agents for 80K professionals, while Deloitte saw 40% productivity gains in finance. However, in a hybrid human-AI workforce, value creation is more nuanced. * Measure time reallocated to creative work **(+40% on average among AI superusers)**. * Track new ideas generated and implemented **(up 33% in organizations with mature AI adoption)**. * Measure the speed-to-decision improvements **(+30% with effective human-AI collaboration)**. * Measure reduction in repetitive tasks (-48% in mature AI organizations). Our global tracker shows 20% higher work satisfaction among those who are satisfied with using AI tools. **We are a team of 7 people managing 51 AI agents and tools**, achieving:. * Where is AI-saved time going? * Which roles are already functioning as human-AI teams? Our insights are based on +250 million data points from individuals and organizations who used our AI-powered tools, participated in our panels and research sessions, or attended our workshops and keynotes. * Why only 2% of AI users save 100s of hours (and you are not)?

results.title: Worker productivity increases 33% per hour Generative AI is used
results.content: # Worker productivity increases 33% per hour Generative AI is used By Aoibhinn McBrideMarch 17, 2025August 13th, 2025No Comments4 min read Home » Worker productivity increases 33% per hour Generative AI is used Whether you work in HR or healthcare, generative AI isn’t just a nice to have or something you can put on the back burner. Recent research reveals that AI productivity is becoming an integral part of work routines. Generative AI has significantly positive implications for productivity across all industries. The data established that 9% of U.S. workers aged 18-64 reported using generative AI every workday. Workers who use generative AI incorporate it into 6% to 25% of their work hours. The data also suggests workers are approximately 33% more productive during hours when they use generative AI. ## AI productivity: time for mass adoption? The researchers also found that those who regularly use generative AI at work save the most time. If you’re in the tech sector, you’re understandably more open to using generative AI at work. For example, information services had both the largest share of work hours spent using generative AI (14%) and the highest time savings (2.6%). In terms of occupations, workers in computer and mathematics used generative AI for 12% of their work hours. By contrast, personal services workers only utilized AI for 1.3% of their work hours. “As more companies formally integrate AI into workflows, we may see these gains materialize more clearly in aggregate productivity measures,” the researchers wrote. “Companies that recognize AI as a talent type — one that improves talent efficiency at the task level, making all other talent types more productive — enjoy solid adoption of AI and learn to rely upon employees to identify and implement high-impact use cases within their areas of expertise.” This approach towards agentic AI can also be seen in industry-specific AI assistants. ## Productivity gains increasing The full potential of agentic AI is yet to be realized. ### AI-led interviews increase job offers by 12%, new research shows ### Younger workers are leading when it comes to AI adoption ## Stay ahead with the Workforce Wire Unlock cutting-edge hiring insights, recruitment strategies, and exclusive opportunities.
